description: Redux reducer module managing general application state slices such as config, license, custom profile attributes, server version, admin setup status, and CWS availability, combining them with combineReducers.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Reducer handling application configuration state, updating on config received, login, license/license set, reset, or logout.

methods.name: license
methods.description: Reducer managing license information, updating on license received, license set, reset, or logout.

methods.name: customProfileAttributes
methods.description: Reducer managing custom user profile attribute fields, handling received, deleted, created, or patched attribute fields.

methods.name: serverVersion
methods.description: Reducer managing server version string, updating on version received or reset on logout.

methods.name: firstAdminVisitMarketplaceStatus
methods.description: Reducer tracking if the first admin visit to marketplace has occurred.

methods.name: firstAdminCompleteSetup
methods.description: Reducer tracking if the first admin setup has been completed.

methods.name: cwsAvailability
methods.description: Reducer managing CWS availability status, handling check request, success, failure, and reset on logout.
